what: Inputs of the second kit that are boolean by declared type alone. What stands here does not count as a refusal: coercion would collapse the third value of such an input into false.

projects/ui-kit-v2/src/lib/components/bu.reason: a tri-state: pressed, not pressed, not said. The third value is what the button is in until the answer arrives, and it is not the same as «not pressed» — coercion would turn it into one.

projects/ui-kit-v2/src/lib/components/ic.reason: a tri-state: open, closed, not said. The third value is a button that opens nothing and carries no aria-expanded at all, and it is not the same as «closed» — coercion would give every icon button of the kit a closed panel it does not have.

projects/ui-kit-v2/src/lib/components/ra.reason: a tri-state: chosen, not chosen, not said. The third value leaves the choice to the form, and it is not the same as «not chosen» — coercion would turn every radio button bound to a form into a not chosen one.
